final: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) as overall_average FROM station_avgs) SELECT sa.observstation, sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - oa.overall_average as difference FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_average ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
